lines.text: The Lord stands beside the altar and orders the tops of the pillars struck so the thresholds shake.
Though they hide atop Hermon, the Lord says He will track them and seize them there.
If they hide at the bottom of the sea, the Lord commands the serpent to bite them.
The LORD says He brought the Philistines up from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
The LORD will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, but all sinners among His people will die by the sword.
